name: Pokémon Gold & Silver
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. All 22 bosses: 8 Johto gyms, 8 Kanto gyms, Elite Four, Champion Lance, and Red at Mt. Silver. Species and levels verified against Bulbapedia leader/gym pages, the Psypokes Gold/Silver walkthrough, and the GameFAQs Gold walkthrough (Scott_and_Linda). Kanto gym order follows the standard post-S.S. Aqua progression (Vermilion -> Saffron -> Celadon -> Fuchsia -> Cerulean -> Pewter -> Seafoam -> Viridian). Blaine's gym is listed at the Seafoam Islands because Cinnabar Island's gym was destroyed by the volcano in Generation II. Lance's levels are the Gold/Silver values (Gyarados 44, Dragonite 47/47/50) - several secondary web sources incorrectly list his higher HeartGold/SoulSilver levels (46/49/49/50) for these games. Lt. Surge's Magneton is level 40 per Bulbapedia (one secondary source says 44, which is his Raichu's level). Moves, abilities, and items intentionally left empty/null per pack spec (Gen II has no abilities).
